garage-floor-reflect.dxbc and garage-floor-reflect-refract.dxbc: the shipped
garage_floor_reflect.fx.fp (ps_5_0, 11,592 bytes) and
garage_floor_reflect_refract.fx.fp (ps_5_0, 11,828 bytes) pixel shaders,
extracted read-only from GRID 2's shaderpack/dx11/shaderpack.pssg (SHA-256
8c86662ffdf412a6f00cafeaf325d5ce47f8ed93bf149db2217d671303df8f0a) at byte
offsets 762551 and 376495. Their renderer fingerprints (FNV-1a 64 of the
bytecode, as passed to CreatePixelShader) are d9571afb84cec177 and
79da3d0d7215a660. The same extraction reproduces the known runtime
fingerprints 2d81beb22b54d6cc, 922a49bc5dcd4775 and 287dc592430a7323.

Both sample a planar reflection map (TReflectionMap/TReflectionMap2, t4/t5 and
t3/t4) at the pixel's screen position and blend
lerp(surface, reflection, lerp(FresnelMin, FresnelMax, f) * specular), plus a
glow of max(reflection - 1, 0) * 0.2. FresnelMin/FresnelMax are $Globals bytes
240..247 in both layouts. The test renders each shader on WARP and requires the
patched draw to match the shader's own output with zero Fresnel and black
reflection inputs byte for byte.
